title: Single Scan Badge Filter
source: 82. Remove Duplicates from Sorted List II
brief: Building security exports badge scans as a chain of ListNode badge IDs sorted in ascending order. Any badge that was scanned more than once in the window is flagged as a possible cloned badge and dropped from the report entirely, so the report only contains badges that were scanned exactly once.
Implement keepSingleScans(head), where head is the first scan in the sorted chain, and return the head of the chain after every badge ID that occurs more than once has been removed completely.
